name: Haus Steissbach
beschreibung: Haus Steissbach is located on a quiet side street in St. Anton am Arlberg. The holiday apartments are equipped with a fully equipped kitchen and a living area. Guests can use the garden as well as parking spaces directly at the house. The location allows a short walk to the Gampenbahn and into the center. The surrounding area offers hiking trails in summer and direct access to the ski areas in winter. Supermarkets and restaurants for daily needs are nearby.
